title: quercus langbianensis subsp. cambodiensis
intro: Quercus langbianensis subsp. cambodiensis, commonly known as a plant species native to Cambodia, is a subspecies of the Quercus langbianensis tree, a type of evergreen oak. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a valuable resource for natural medicine. Bioactive constituents present in Quercus langbianensis subsp. cambodiensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
